description: Robustness DEV set (14): the ad-hoc questions that exposed the out-of-scope, everyday-wording, relative-time, multi-item and breakdown failures; used while building the fixes.

queries.question: is agriculture a profitable venture in andaman
has rice farming gone down in andaman?
queries.gold_sql: SELECT o.period_label, MIN(o.value), MAX(o.value) FROM observation o WHERE o.metric_id='production' AND o.commodity_id='paddy' AND o.location_id='AN' AND json_extract(o.dims,'$.item') IS NULL AND json_extract(o.dims,'$.variety') IS NULL AND o.value IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.period_label ORDER BY MIN(o.period_start)

queries.question: what's the costliest vegetable in port blair
compare paddy and arecanut area in north and middle andaman
why is paddy production falling
queries.gold_sql: SELECT o.period_label, MIN(o.value), MAX(o.value) FROM observation o WHERE o.metric_id='production' AND o.commodity_id='paddy' AND o.location_id='AN' AND json_extract(o.dims,'$.item') IS NULL AND json_extract(o.dims,'$.variety') IS NULL AND o.value IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.period_label ORDER BY MIN(o.period_start)

queries.question: tell me about onion prices last year
queries.gold_sql: SELECT o.period_label, MIN(o.value), MAX(o.value) FROM observation o WHERE o.metric_id='retail_price' AND o.commodity_id='onion' AND o.location_id='MKT_AN' AND json_extract(o.dims,'$.item') IS NULL AND json_extract(o.dims,'$.variety') IS NULL AND o.value IS NOT NULL AND o.period_start>='2025-01-01' AND o.period_start<='2025-12-31' GROUP BY o.period_label ORDER BY MIN(o.period_start)

queries.question: how many tractors are there in nicobar district
where is the most paddy grown?
queries.gold_sql: SELECT o.location_id, MAX(o.value) FROM observation o JOIN location l ON l.location_id=o.location_id WHERE o.metric_id='production' AND o.commodity_id='paddy' AND l.level='district' AND o.period_label='2025-26' AND json_extract(o.dims,'$.item') IS NULL AND json_extract(o.dims,'$.variety') IS NULL AND o.value IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.location_id ORDER BY 2 DESC

queries.question: how much coconut does nicobar produce
queries.gold_sql: SELECT o.document_id, o.page, o.value FROM observation o WHERE o.metric_id='production' AND o.commodity_id='coconut' AND o.location_id='AN_NIC' AND o.period_label='2025-26' AND json_extract(o.dims,'$.item') IS NULL AND json_extract(o.dims,'$.variety') IS NULL AND o.value IS NOT NULL

queries.question: which island has the most farmers
queries.gold_sql: SELECT o.location_id, MAX(o.value) FROM observation o JOIN location l ON l.location_id=o.location_id WHERE o.metric_id='farmers_count' AND o.commodity_id IS NULL AND l.level='island' AND o.period_label='2024-25' AND json_extract(o.dims,'$.item') IS NULL AND json_extract(o.dims,'$.variety') IS NULL AND o.value IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.location_id ORDER BY 2 DESC
